title: Dark Riot Font
author: DREAM
description:
**Dark Riot – Bold Graffiti Punk Display Font**
Unleash your rebellious side with **Dark Riot**, a raw, edgy display font inspired by underground punk culture, graffiti lettering, horror aesthetics, and rebellious street art.
Featuring rough hand-drawn shapes, sharp edges, irregular letterforms, and a distinctive dripping style, Dark Riot brings a powerful underground attitude to your creative projects. Its bold, unconventional appearance is designed to make headlines stand out and give your artwork an unmistakable alternative edge.
**Perfect For:**
– Punk Rock & Metal Band Posters
– Horror Movie Titles & Dark Artwork
– Album Covers & Music Graphics
– Streetwear & Urban Branding
– Graffiti & Grunge Designs
– Halloween Graphics & Spooky Projects
– Skateboard Graphics & Alternative Merchandise
– Event Flyers, Stickers & Experimental Typography
**Product Features:**
– Unique graffiti-inspired display lettering
– Bold, edgy, hand-drawn aesthetic
– Punk, grunge, horror, and street-art influence
– Great for eye-catching headlines and statement designs
– OpenType (OTF) font file
– Compatible with Windows
**What’s Included:**
– 1 × Dark Riot OTF Font File
**File Format:** OTF (OpenType Font)
**Compatibility:** Windows
Give your designs a raw, rebellious voice with Dark Riot — a display font made for bold ideas, underground energy, and unforgettable visuals.
**Note:** Please check the included character set and glyph support before purchasing to ensure the font meets your project requirements.
